description: A group of three highschooler. 2 of us did the challenge last year, and we want to do better.
summary: We developed a Lunar landing site evaluation device that can analyzes moon data and terrain to check if a landing site is good for a satellite/lander.
details: This project finds an altitude map from LOLA around the user specified landing site. It picks the coordinate closest to the landing site. From the map we also create a max altitude map in 360 degrees, giving us the real angles of the horizon. We use this map as a second pass for our Sun/Earth rise/set times after JPL Horizons gives us the Ephemeris tables.
